authorship: Frozen independently from the scheduling implementation using week-end event ledgers. Constructed outcomes, not observed company data.

steady.ledger: Week 1 installs 001/002; week 2 hands those over while installing 003/004; the separate pools continue concurrently.

reduced_capacity.ledger: Both pools have one slot throughout; the first installation enters QA in week 2.

new_hold.ledger: At the start of week 2 home 001 is held before QA, with no known release. Home 002 alone hands over in week 2.

withdrawal.ledger: At the start of week 2 home 002 withdraws. This stops only that home's future stages and is not a forecast of financial closure.

qa_return.ledger: Home 001 fails its week 2 QA and re-enters QA in week 3 before higher IDs. Reinspection uses one full QA slot-week.

missing_input.ledger: Capacity evidence is absent. There is no prediction, no zero-filled series and no numeric error score.
